GitHub Gist
Manual sync stores encrypted conversations, memories, presets, prompts, and appearance settings in a private Gist. API keys, provider URLs, search keys, and proxy settings stay on this device. Push now creates the Gist; Pull now remains manual.
Not configured
Add a GitHub token and passphrase, then push to create or update your private sync Gist.
Pairing
The pairing code can fill the Gist ID and passphrase on another device. Only include the token if you trust the room and the receiving device.
Backup
Backups exclude API keys, search credentials, sync tokens, and passphrases.
